Load /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-10_input.step. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). For this task, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-10_input.step`.

Keep the 130 x 110 x 14 mm outside envelope. Cut one centered through rounded-rectangle window centered at (65,55), overall size 64 x 46 mm, with 8 mm corner radii. Cut four blind circular top relief pockets of diameter 12 mm and depth 5 mm at (22,22), (108,22), (22,88), and (108,88); these pockets start from the top face and must not pass through the bottom. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-10_output.step.
